issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 19.3% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Portland, OR plant pays 19.3% premium above best-plant pricing for 227 materials sourced from Pacific Fasteners LLC through Oracle NetSuite, representing $1,624,369 in excess costs over the trailing 12 months. Root cause is lack of cross-plant price harmonization and absence of corporate-level agreement enforcement in NetSuite.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct emergency price benchmarking across all plants for the 227 materials from Pacific Fasteners LLC to identify best-plant prices and document price variance by SKU
Negotiate corporate-level pricing agreement with Pacific Fasteners LLC based on best-plant rates, targeting 19.3% reduction for Portland plant with volume consolidation leverage across all facilities
Update Oracle NetSuite item records and vendor price lists for all 227 materials to reflect new corporate pricing, creating price-variance alerts for purchases exceeding agreed rates

Implement mandatory corporate agreement compliance policy in NetSuite with PO approval workflow requiring Category Manager sign-off for any Pacific Fasteners purchases deviating >5% from standard pricing
Establish quarterly price audits comparing Portland plant actual spend vs. corporate agreement for Pacific Fasteners LLC with automatic escalation to VP Procurement for variances >3%

plan.expected_impact: Eliminate the 19.3% price premium to capture $1,624,369 in annual savings through corporate price harmonization for 227 materials from Pacific Fasteners LLC.
kpis: Price variance reduction: Target 0% premium vs. best plant by end of Quarter 1
Savings realization: $1,624,369 annual run-rate within 90 days
Contract compliance rate: 100% of Portland POs at corporate pricing within 60 days
Purchase order count at standard price: Track weekly for 227 materials
risks: Pacific Fasteners LLC may resist 19.3% price reduction for Portland; mitigation is volume consolidation commitment across all plants
NetSuite price master data quality issues may delay implementation; require data validation before go-live
Maverick buying through non-standard requisition channels could bypass new controls; enforce PO mandatory policy
Portland plant may have unique material specifications justifying premium; validate SKU equivalency during benchmarking
erp_actions: Oracle NetSuite: Update vendor price lists for Pacific Fasteners LLC (Vendor ID) with new corporate rates for all 227 item records, effective contract start date
Oracle NetSuite: Configure custom price variance alert (>5% threshold) in PO creation workflow for Pacific Fasteners LLC purchases at Portland subsidiary
Oracle NetSuite: Create custom approval routing rule requiring Category Manager authorization for Pacific Fasteners LLC POs from Portland exceeding corporate pricing
Oracle NetSuite: Enable contract management module to link all Pacific Fasteners LLC POs to master corporate agreement with spend tracking dashboard
Oracle NetSuite: Block legacy vendor records for Pacific Fasteners LLC at Portland subsidiary; consolidate to single corporate vendor master record
